body:
This PR adds an option called `TemperatureDependentIceNumber` to be used in non-equilibrium formation of cloud ice (i.e. deposition/sublimation). The timescale is computed as for `PrescribedIceNumber`, τ = 1/(4π D_v N r), with the mono-disperse radius, but with the ice number concentration prescribed as a function of temperature

 N_ice(T) = min(N_ref exp(a + b max(T_freeze - T, 0)), N_max), 
 
instead of the constant number N_0. The relationship is based on [Meyers et al 1992](https://journals.ametsoc.org/view/journals/apme/31/7/1520-0450_1992_031_0708_npinpi_2_0_co_2.xml)

The timescale is hours in the mixed-phase range (7 h at -10 °C for q_icl = 1e-5 kg/kg) and seconds to minutes at cirrus temperatures, so supercooled liquid is not glaciated within a few model steps. The timescale is very slow for sub-zero temperatures.
title: Temperature dependent N_ice for cloud ice formation
